description: SP ENW - Capital Projects - Investment Map is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - Capital Projects – Investment Map Our capital delivery programme is a dedicated single function to deliver the network investment needed to strengthen the North West’s electricity network, improve reliability, increase capacity, support low carbon technologies, and create a cleaner, greener, more resilient energy future to meet the needs ... Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Reference Data. Its keywords are Capital, Projeccts, Investment Map, Battery Storage Persona, Distributed Generator Persona, Industrial & Commercial Persona. The portal shows 2026-07-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
